accepted_scope_caveats.label: thm:rectifiable-exact-frontier / honest_scope
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: The logarithmic equivalence is asserted only on the separately defined primitive two-sided-thickness class, not on Cattaneo–Titiunik–Yu's P_NP class.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: The predicted logarithmic frontier holds conditionally on P_rect(q,L,c_-,r_0); transfer to the anchor's class remains open.

source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper requires a rectifiable curve with positive length in Assumption 2(i), and Theorem 6 requires a rectifiable support boundary, but neither location states a uniform lower-and-upper curve-length envelope.

The inspected model uses compact C^2 submanifolds and reach bounds with a bounded density on the support; it does not state arbitrary C^{\iota+2} chart regularity, a uniform chart-derivative envelope, or a parameter-speed lower bound.
The location-based method retains the bivariate score and gives uniform two-dimensional local-polynomial error expressions with h^{p+1} bias and (nh^2)^{-1/2}-scale stochastic error.
